summary: PASS — Internal Cost Report modal verified end-to-end in the live UI for both SIMPLE and MULTI-PART quote paths. Simple: with one-up 12×10, qty=1000, the modal opens with summary 'FOB: Will-Call | Pricing: Simple', a 17-column detail table (cost-report-table-0) and a populated row (cost-report-row-0-0) showing Qty=1,000 / Sheets=17 / MSF=0.9 / Sheet=63×126 / Route=CAD / Material=$185 / Print=$212 / Cutter=$136 / Finish=$0 / Frt=$0 / OH=$0 / Tot Mfg=$583 / $/MSF=$622 / Sell=$1,115 / S/MSF=$1,190 / GM%=47.8% / GM$=$533 — NO Kit Rollup and NO cost-report-item-1 (correct for single-component). Multi-Part: switching to Multi-Part auto-opened the BOM Builder, picked the 'Counter Display' template (2 active MFG components: Counter Tray + Header Card), Save BOM closed the modal and produced a 2-item BOM strip. Opening Cost Report rendered TWO per-component cards (cost-report-item-0, cost-report-item-1), a 17-col table for Counter Tray with 3 tier rows, AND the Kit Rollup section (cost-report-rollup) with 3 rollup rows — rollup-row-0 had 7 cells (Set Qty=500, Components=2, Total Cost=$288, Charges=$0, Total Sell=$527, GM$=$238, GM%=45.3%) confirming the rollup column order from CostReportModal.jsx L252. Pricing mode was 'Individual', so the Price/Set column is correctly omitted (gated by isMatchedSet). Summary bar shows 'FOB: Will-Call | Prepress: Per Item | Pricing: Individual'.

critical_code_review_comments: CostReportModal.jsx norm() (L24-51) correctly handles both Simple results rows AND MP componentPricing rows via the same field-name surface — confirmed by both paths populating Material/Print/Cutter/Tot Mfg/Sell/GM%/GM$ identically.
Kit Rollup gating (L96) `isMultiPart && componentPricing.length > 1 && results.length > 0` is correct — Simple correctly suppresses the rollup section, MP w/ 2 components shows it.

Rollup column ordering in JSX (L252) matches the row data extraction in L104-114 exactly (Set Qty, Components, Total Cost, Charges, Total Sell, GM$, GM%, +optional Price/Set). 7-cell row verified live.
isMatchedSet gating of the Price/Set column (L252, L267) is correct — verified by Individual mode producing 7-cell rollup rows; Matched Set would produce 8.
Per-item empty-state ('Enter dimensions and quantities to see costs', L234-236) is the right UX fallback when a component has no pricable rows — observed live on Header Card.
Cost-report-row testids use {ri}-{di} pattern (L211) — stable for downstream regression scripts.

Backend engine_routes.py componentPricing rows_out enrichment (matTotal/matMakeready/printDirect/cutterDirect/saberCost/assemblyCost/overhead/sheetsReq) confirmed in live UI by non-zero values populating the 17-col table for the MP card. The pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_cost_report_fields.py (4/4 PASS per main agent) is the canonical regression for this field set.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cost Report modal (CostReportModal.jsx) is verified working for both Simple and Multi-Part paths. Reliable testids for future regression: toolbar-cost-report (open), modal-cost-report (container), cost-report-summary, cost-report-table-{ri}, cost-report-row-{ri}-{di}, cost-report-item-{ri}, cost-report-rollup, cost-report-rollup-row-{i}, cost-report-close-btn, cost-report-print-btn. To build an MP quote quickly in a script: click tile-quote-multipart → BOM Builder auto-opens → click bom-tpl-counter (or any built-in template with 2+ active rows) → click bom-save. Per-component dims live on the standard input-one-up-w / input-one-up-l / input-qty-0 fields, scoped to the currently-active bom-item (switch via clicking bom-item-{i} in the BOM strip). NOTE: setQty[0..2] is shared across components in MP, so editing qty-0 from a different component changes the shared lot qty — that's by design. If a future test needs Matched Set rollup with Price/Set, set s.pricingMode='Matched Set' (pricing strategy section) before opening the report — the 8th rollup column will appear.
